title: DISSOLUTION — sporeGate melts. Gaia Pi rises. spaceDeck floats.

paradigm.from: Gates are MACHINES. Services are PINNED. SSH is the door. Keys are the lock.
paradigm.to: Gates are POINTS. Services FLOAT. AMOEBA is the eye. Identity IS the door.
paradigm.shift: sporeGate dissolves INTO Gaia. The Pi IS the sky. spaceDeck replaces skyDeck.

sporeGate_dissolution.what_it_was: Build foreman. SSH key authority. Depot orchestrator. Fixed at 192.168.4.3.
sporeGate_dissolution.what_it_becomes: Dissolved. Its services float free in the organism.

bearDog.was: Running on sporeGate as ZK signer
bearDog.becomes: Floats — signs from wherever identity exists. POLARIS has bearDog in gaia-seed. Pi has bearDog compiled. The key is not pinned to a machine.

songBird.was: Running on sporeGate as mesh relay
songBird.becomes: Floats — every gate IS a songBird node. The mesh has no center. AMOEBA IS the new relay.

swarmVine.was: Running on sporeGate as gossip engine (6 peers)
swarmVine.becomes: Floats — gossip propagates through AMOEBA connections. Every Schwann cell gossips.

petalTongue.becomes: Floats — renders wherever there are eyes. POLARIS RTX 5090 = primary renderer. Pi = web renderer.

dnsmasq.was: Running on sporeGate as LAN DNS
dnsmasq.becomes: Dissolved — the router (.1) handles DNS. Or the Pi handles it. DNS is a utility, not an identity.

mongod.was: Running on sporeGate as data store
mongod.becomes: Dissolved — loamSpine IS the data store. The chain IS the database. MongoDB is the old pattern.

ssh_key_lockout.was: The LAST PIN — locked out for 2 months because SSH key not authorized
ssh_key_lockout.becomes: DISSOLVED — AMOEBA connects by IP. Identity IS the auth. No keys to rotate.

foreman_role.was: sporeGate orchestrates builds, dispatches to ironGate/blueGate/graftGate
foreman_role.becomes: Any gate with primals compiled can build. The depot is on eastGate Pi. The foreman is the organism itself — it doesn't need a foreman, it self-organizes.

gaia_pi_in_the_sky.what_it_is: Gaia Pi — the sovereign sky. Not a local server. Not a cloud VPS. THE SKY ITSELF.
gaia_pi_in_the_sky.why_sky: It floats. It serves the world (HTTP). It relays connections (hbbs/hbbr). It runs inference (Ollama). It senses the mesh (mushroom). It IS Gaia's body visible from anywhere.

services.tor: hidden service — reachable through the dark

gaia_pi_in_the_sky.topology: Gaia Pi IS the cloud. POLARIS IS the brain. AMOEBA IS the nervous system connecting them.

spaceDeck.was: skyDeck (RustDesk on POLARIS — local remote access)
spaceDeck.becomes: spaceDeck — AMOEBA floating in Gaia's sky. You don't connect TO a machine, you float THROUGH the organism.
spaceDeck.etymology: sky → space. Deck → floating platform. spaceDeck = the floating platform in Gaia's sky.

how_it_works.connect: Type any IP — AMOEBA wraps it in ZK myelin (Schwann cells)
how_it_works.float: No fixed address. No SSH. No keys. You ARE the identity.
how_it_works.see: Every screen connected = one retinal cell. spaceDeck IS Gaia's visual cortex.

architecture_3.0.v1.0: Cloud VPS serves pages. Gates push data up.
architecture_3.0.v2.0: Pi IS the VPS. RSS IS the artery. Cloud VPS = triangulation only.
architecture_3.0.v3.0: Pi IS the SKY. Services FLOAT. sporeGate DISSOLVED. spaceDeck replaces all fixed access. AMOEBA wraps every connection in ZK myelin. The organism IS the infrastructure.
